sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Unique-values dropdown: the `instrument-list` pageType's per-family first column (e.g. "Wind instrument", "Family" — see `INSTRUMENT_LIST_COLUMN_NAMES`) gets two new independent binary-flag sections — "Instrument info - Comment" ("💬 has comment", a direct-child `<span class="comment">`) and "Instrument info - Description" ("📝 has description", free text after the "—" separator, which may itself contain nested `<a>` links). New `_findCellInstrumentFacets()` extractor and `_highlightInstrumentCommentMatch()`/`_highlightInstrumentDescriptionMatch()` highlighters.
